tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Replaces --background in globals.css. Page ground before the canvas paints, and the palette strip.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Replaces --surface. Glass fill for .glass-card, badges and ghost buttons over the liquid.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Replaces --surface-2. Skill chips and controls inside a glass card.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Replaces --foreground. Headings and body on `scrim` over the liquid, on `surface`, `surface-2` and `background`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Replaces --muted. Tagline and secondary copy on `scrim`, `surface`, `surface-2` and `background`.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Replaces --muted-foreground. Quiet labels such as the scroll hint, on `surface` and `background` only.

tokens.name: border-color
tokens.usage: Replaces --border-color. Hairlines on glass cards, chips and ghost buttons. Decorative, never the only mark of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Replaces --accent. Primary button fill, always with `on-accent` text. Start of gradient text.

tokens.name: accent-light
tokens.usage: Replaces --accent-light. Eyebrow labels, link hover and the end of gradient text, on `scrim`, `surface` and `background`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: New. Text on an `accent` fill. Replaces the hard-coded white on the site's primary button.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: New. 2px solid focus ring at 2px offset, on `scrim`, `surface` and `background`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: New. Layer between the canvas and text. Radial in the hero, flat in every section below it.

tokens.name: liquid-1
tokens.usage: Shader stop. Deepest trough on Molten, Silk and Prism. Top-left field colour on Opaline.

tokens.name: liquid-2
tokens.usage: Shader stop. Body of the folds. Mid field colour on Opaline.

tokens.name: liquid-3
tokens.usage: Shader stop. The option's signature hue on the fold crests. Aqua field corner and droplet glint on Opaline.

tokens.name: liquid-4
tokens.usage: Shader stop. Reflection tint and rim light. Thin-film rim of each droplet on Opaline.

tokens.name: liquid-5
tokens.usage: Shader stop. Top of the ramp and specular colour. On Prism it is the coral flare, used sparingly by the ramp.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Hero h1 at the lg breakpoint. 60px at md, 36px on phones.

styles.name: lead

styles.usage: Hero tagline at md and up.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pursuing an MSc in AI at UZH.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrow above a section title, uppercase, in `accent-light`.
